verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs say you describe what you want and it generates a working app with frontend, backend, database, authentication and integrations, with hosting and publishing built in. Hands-on reports confirm apps get built from prompts, such as internal CRUD tools and scaffolding that "did a great job". The same reports note generated code is only okay, lumps everything into one JS file, and can perform poorly; these limit quality but do not contradict that a working full-stack app is produced. Missing for 10: independent evidence that generated apps are production-grade in code structure and performance, and corroboration beyond prototypes and internal tools for complex apps.

support.subject: As a founder, I can describe an app in natural language and get a working full-stack application

citations.quote: You describe what you want to build, and Lovable generates a working application that includes frontend, backend, database, authentication, and integrations, all backed by editable code.
Lovable hosts your app and includes a built-in backend (Cloud) with database, authentication, storage, edge functions, and AI, no infrastructure setup required.
Describe the data your app needs in chat, and Lovable creates the tables and schema for you.
I recently used lovable to create the scaffolding for an app. It did a great job, far better than I expected.
